goal.request: Strengthen visual-semantics and candidate-pack data from the referenced fantasy and illusion terminology research while keeping broad mood, genre, internal-state, natural-optics, and temporal labels from becoming unsupported hard pixel claims.

evidence.claim: Primary research, scientific references, museum records, and scholarly reference works support bounded visual relations for dream discontinuity, reversible perception, impossible topology, liminal transition, matter-of-fact anomaly, reflection mismatch, face pareidolia, continuous metamorphosis, and apparatus-bound phantasmagoria, while exposing limits for lucid dreaming, hallucination, time, memory, Surrealism, mirage, and afterimage.

The runtime sources contain nine five-component visual profiles and fifty-seven complete candidate entries across subject, action, prop, location, composition, surreal relation, anchor, physics, reflection, transition, and aftermath slots.
The authored JSON, fifteen evidence rows, registry schema, generated visual-profile index, and sharded semantic index are structurally valid and bound to the current merged sources.

evidence.claim: Focused tests pass direct single-profile activation, broad and advisory negatives, close visual substitutes, component and gate completeness, candidate completeness, approved evidence binding, optional-only embedding discovery, and generated-index ownership.

Fantasy, natural-environment, and visual-profile retrieval regressions remain green. The full visual-obligation module reports six failures caused exclusively by an extra clinical_nursing_duty_system activation in existing yandere cases; no imaginal profile appears in those failures, so the unrelated merged-worktree issue is retained rather than rewritten in this intervention.

perceptual_contract.primary_success_condition: A narrow imaginal request resolves into a falsifiable relationship among reality anchor, rule breach, comparison boundary, response or process, and localized physical consequence, while broad or internal-state terminology stays advisory unless the requester supplies a concrete definition.

invariants.statement: Every promoted imaginal profile requires five observable component groups and five pixel review gates rather than a mood word, palette, glow, fog, famous motif, or isolated prop.
causal_controls: narrow direct term activates only its intended profile
close visual substitute remains a negative control
semantic similarity creates an optional candidate only

invariants.statement: Dream discontinuity, external-stimulus illusion, subjective unshared perception, natural atmospheric optics, reflection breach, projection apparatus, and fictional world rules retain separate data ownership.
causal_controls: mirage and Fata Morgana remain natural-optics concepts
visual hallucination remains advisory and carries no diagnosis or cause inference
phantasmagoria requires visible projection apparatus and receiving medium

invariants.statement: Package and prompt-routing success cannot be reported as rendered-pixel fidelity, perceptual dual-read success, aesthetic fantasy quality, or user approval.
causal_controls: no image generation is used as hidden validation

flexible_dimensions: camera and lighting choices that preserve the evidence relation
specific source and target forms of metamorphosis
the two recognizable readings of an ambiguous figure
requester definitions that override the registry default meaning

mismatches.source_state: The referenced conversation groups dreams, hallucinations, optical illusions, natural optics, artistic movements, genre aesthetics, time, memory, materials, places, and supernatural entities under a broad fantasy-related vocabulary.
mismatches.render_state: Only a narrow subset has stable single-still relations; hardening the full list would invent palettes, props, diagnoses, temporality, causality, or genre rules that pixels cannot prove.

mismatches.source_state: Dreamy, ethereal, otherworldly, oneiric, and surreal are often represented by blur, bloom, pastel light, fog, or floating objects.
mismatches.render_state: The target data needs one identifiable reality anchor, one bounded rule breach, one comparison seam, continuity across that seam, and localized physical evidence.

mismatches.source_state: A double exposure, inserted face, costume overlay, hologram, or fog silhouette can look superficially close to the requested concept.
mismatches.render_state: The target requires corresponding mirror geometry, continuous nonface substrate, one-body source-target bridge, or visible apparatus-light-screen causality respectively.

hypotheses.statement: Encoding reality anchor, rule breach, comparison boundary, continuity, and physical consequence will prevent atmospheric treatment from substituting for the requested imaginal meaning.
hypotheses.falsifier: A broad dreamy or surreal phrase activates a new hard profile, or a narrow direct phrase lacks one of the five component groups.

hypotheses.statement: Candidate clusters spanning subject, action, anchor prop, location, composition, physics, and aftermath will keep generation focused on a complete perceptual or causal relation rather than an isolated fantasy object.
hypotheses.falsifier: A new evidence row references a missing candidate, or a candidate lacks bilingual labels, aliases, keywords, semantic text, or a coherent slot owner.

hypotheses.statement: Keeping lucid awareness, hallucination, time, memory, broad Surrealism, mirage, and afterimage in an optional advisory lane will preserve creativity without turning internal, temporal, clinical, or natural-optics claims into hard visual facts.
hypotheses.falsifier: An advisory or embedding-only phrase becomes hard-eligible, or a natural-optics term activates an imaginal profile.

intervention.general_rule: Promote only imaginal meanings that can be falsified through an explicit single-frame perceptual, spatial, reflective, transformational, or projection relation; keep mood, genre, internal-state, temporal, diagnostic, and natural-optics labels advisory.
intervention.generalization_basis: The same anchor-breach-boundary-continuity-consequence method applies across dream space, reversible figures, impossible topology, transition places, ordinary anomalies, mirrors, nonface patterns, metamorphosis, and projection media while allowing each concept to own distinct confound controls.

covered_axes: idle projector hologram and actual ghost

decision.rationale: The source-backed contracts, candidate extension, regenerated indexes, direct and negative routing holdouts, and three related regression modules pass at package and imaginal prompt-behavior layers. The full visual-obligation module has a separately identified clinical-nursing false activation in existing yandere cases and no imaginal profile in its failures; that unrelated merged-worktree issue remains outside this intervention. No render or user evidence was collected, so the work is implemented without a rendered-pixel, perceptual-success, or aesthetic-approval claim.
